digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate T13 and code-review surface-parity overlay
propositions: T13 plan-review overlay currently triggers only on prohibitions (new forbidding actions); widening to additive obligations (new contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments) requires updating the trigger lexicon in the rubric and routing configuration

The deterministic pre-gate in det_gate_rules.py lacks additive-obligation vocabulary patterns and will skip plans that use such phrasing before the router can apply T13, requiring a second alternation branch for correct enforcement

Historical assessment of surface-parity widening to cover CLI→MCP/NDJSON parity shows 70% of potential triggers lack genuine obligations, 10% are true positives now covered deterministically by write_parity_contract, and the single demonstrated FP family does not justify LLM-criterion approach

P0 (import-integrity criterion) is resolved by building deterministic CI import-walk instead of LLM-based check; P3 (project.obligation-parity overlay) is rejected as deterministically measurable without new criterion
Generated guide documentation must be regenerated via src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_guide.py to ensure consistency with the updated criteria registry, failing if hand-edited
